title: National Analysis: indicators and PESTLE pressure by year
keyNote: The World Bank's three-letter codes: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, save XKX (Kosovo) and CHI (the Channel Islands), which ISO does not assign. The ISO numeric and Gleditsch–Ward codes (num, gw), where a country has them, are in national/data/index.json; CHI has neither, so no border layer draws it.
note: Each file lists the countries in the order given here; values[k][year - from] is the k-th country's value for that year, null where there is none. Nothing is carried forward. The years are VM's request window, 1980 (where Country PESTLE began) to the newest year the World Bank holds. Values are for present-day countries: a year before a state existed, or before its borders took today's shape, is the World Bank's reconstruction for its present territory, not a figure of the time. In open and openPeriod, {at} is the frame's year and {from} and {to} the window's first and last, in AD years, as the Omni-Map's recipe gives them (USP 3.2). Per-country series of every indicator: national/data/series/<ISO3>.json.

layers.title: PESTLE pressure, by year
layers.unit: share of scored indicators worsening, 0–1 (each field's own unit and scale: fieldUnits)

political.unit: share of the political dimension's scored indicators worsening, 0–1

economic.unit: share of the economic dimension's scored indicators worsening, 0–1

social.unit: share of the social dimension's scored indicators worsening, 0–1

technological.unit: share of the technological dimension's scored indicators worsening, 0–1

legal.unit: share of the legal dimension's scored indicators worsening, 0–1

environmental.unit: share of the environmental dimension's scored indicators worsening, 0–1

coverage.unit: share of the 22 core indicators with a value that year, 0–1

dims.unit: dimensions scored, a count from 0 to 6 (fewer than six is partial)

floor.note: On the page, a score from fewer than 3 of the six dimensions is shown in words but not coloured or ranked, and a period's two ends are compared only where both rest on the same dimensions. The values here are the rule's, unfiltered.

layers.legend: Share of a dimension's scored indicators worsening; fewer than six dimensions is partial

source.citation: Vitruvian Manager, National Analysis, PESTLE pressure (after Country PESTLE), from World Bank WDI and WGI
source.licence: World Bank data CC BY 4.0; method © JDP-Iq

layers.method: VM's own composite (an estimate VM derives), not a forecast or a ranking of how well a country is run. For each of the 22 core indicators, the value of the year (or one up to 2 years older, never more) is compared with the country's previous value no more than 5 years before it; a change past the indicator's threshold is improving or worsening. A dimension's pressure is the share of its scored indicators worsening; overall pressure is the mean of the dimensions scored (dims, 0–6; fewer than six is partial); coverage is the share of the 22 with a value. 1980 has a coverage but no score, as a change needs an earlier value; VM's build asks the World Bank for 1980 onwards, so for a value from before 1985 the look-back stops at 1980. Recompute it from the wb: layers with national/lib/pestle.js (scoreYear).
layers.pinNote: Rebuilt monthly from World Bank data, which is revised.
layers.omniNote: VM's composite; double-counting: the Omni-Map takes the wb: indicators instead, and this stays on National Analysis.
